svg.title: B2 PORTS B + METERS from above
svg.text: FRONT EDGE (lid side): the card slides in from here
BACK EDGE (snapped, filed flat): header (column j, rows 1-18) plugs into the backplane
B2 PORTS B + METERS: from above, 9 px/mm; SolderFul 81.3 x 50.8 mm with the back rails snapped off: 81.3 x 41.91 mm [TBD-MEASURE]
cups (wind speed) pulse at the jack
sensor port 4 clock (SCL) at the jack
sensor port 4 data (SDA) at the jack
spare bus line (for the charger interrupt)
solid line: jumper, wire or lead on top, as routed
dashed line: wire on the underside, as routed
ring on the front edge: lead leaving the card (to the charger, the pack)
diamond: pad with a soldered lead
grey dashed box: plug or service keep-out
